title: Vannevar Bush's post-war science structures left as a 'zombie'
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of Vannevar Bush's post-war science structures left as a 'zombie', about 1940s to present at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We had these genius administrators like Vanavar Bush and they set up these structures and the structures worked pretty well but then they didn't pass the knowledge of what the structures were

plain: A mathematician and commentator named Eric Weinstein says on Jesse Michels's podcast that brilliant science administrators of the 1940s, such as Vannevar Bush, who ran US government science during the Second World War, built systems for organizing research that worked well. But, he says, they never passed down the knowledge of what those systems were for, so the systems keep running like a zombie. If true, it would mean nobody now fully understands the secret science structures still in place.
